name: Llama
summary: Meta's family of open-weight models, downloadable and runnable on your own hardware, and the most widely used base for locally-hosted and privately-deployed assistants.
freeTierNotes: Weights are free to download under a community licence. Running them costs hardware and electricity rather than a subscription.
tosNotes: Released under a community licence with conditions, not a standard open-source licence. Read the licence before commercial deployment.
